modes.description: Words in statements about something being tiny, negligible or very unlikely.

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words like 'impossible' and 'ineffective' and away from 'often' and 'usually'.
card.plain: It lights up when text is about to give a stretch of past years, and weakly in statements about something being extremely unlikely.
